status: source-only uncertainty propagation frozen after V19CB demonstrated that no foreground treatment resolves the association, before reading a WALLABY kinematic row, rotation speed, velocity field, gravity residual, halo result, sample split or holdout score
purpose: Replace an unjustified hard H I/optical counterpart choice with a deterministic discrete mixture over every source-only candidate, carrying all four foreground-treatment scenarios and all four beam-kernel scenarios separately into future baryonic inference.

mixture_definition.unnormalized_candidate_weight: q_i,b,k = max(0, spatial_lr_i,k) times the already declared V19CB foreground weight for candidate i in treatment branch b
mixture_definition.normalized_candidate_weight: p_i,b,k = q_i,b,k / sum_j q_j,b,k when the sum is positive
mixture_definition.undefined_scenario_rule: If every q is zero, retain every candidate, leave every normalized weight blank and flag that release/treatment/kernel scenario as undefined; do not invent a uniform fallback.
mixture_definition.future_discrete_marginal_likelihood: L_release,b,k(theta) = sum_i p_i,b,k times L(data_release given candidate_i, theta); gravity or kinematic likelihoods may never update p_i,b,k or choose b or k.

claim_boundary: V19CE does not identify an optical counterpart and does not turn source-side ranking scores into a validated posterior probability.
The normalized weights are deterministic uncertainty scenarios for later marginalization, not evidence that their highest-weight object is the galaxy.
Hard-zero foreground branches remain counterfactual diagnostics and are never promoted to data masks.
No velocity, rotation curve, lensing result, halo map, gravity residual, action, constant, holdout label or Solar-System result enters the mixture.
